subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should OpenClaw accept the core reply-footer quota-window behavior through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96339, including its bounded omit-on-timeout lookup, or reject/narrow it?
rationale: This is new user-visible core footer behavior over provider/auth data, and the active implementation has an explicit timeout/caching tradeoff that automation should not decide on maintainer behalf.

options.title: Review and land the active PR
options.body: Accept the existing generic provider-usage hook bridge, with any requested timeout or cache adjustments made in the PR before merge.

options.title: Request design changes first
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open but require a different cache/preload or display policy before provider quota windows appear in reply footers.

options.title: Reject footer quota display
options.body: Close the active PR and then close this issue with a maintainer explanation that `/status` remains the supported quota surface.

recommendation.title: Review and land the active PR
recommendation.body: Accept the existing generic provider-usage hook bridge, with any requested timeout or cache adjustments made in the PR before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the provider-usage/status plumbing and already scoped this issue's desired implementation boundary in the discussion.
